; Native PDF and notebook reader overlay.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 10000
                source: "file:///home/root/remarkabl/pdf-panel.qml"
                onLoaded: item.captureTarget = parent
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
